contract: Product: Sheggar Wheels — an Addis Ababa peer-to-peer car rental marketplace. Job: let a renter find and book a nearby car, let an owner manage a fleet and respond to requests, and let an admin run the marketplace — all from one role-aware dashboard. Primary action for renters: Browse cars, reinforced by the dashboard CTA. Primary action for owners: respond to booking requests and add cars. Primary action for admins: clear the listing review queue. Hierarchy: public routes keep the sticky shadcnblocks Navbar1 and footer; authenticated routes use a shared dark-ink sidebar shell with a sticky topbar, role-scoped navigation, and a content canvas of page header → KPI stat row → primary work card → secondary insight panel. Target viewports: 390x844 and 1440x900. Reference: the zen-linen shadcn theme (21st.dev/@serafimcloud/themes/zen-linen) — warm linen background #E9E4D8, cream cards #F4EFE4, charcoal primary #2E2E2E, sand secondary, muted clay accents, 0.5rem radius — with Roboto as the sole typeface, extended by shadcn sidebar tokens (dark ink sidebar, sand foreground, ember active indicator).

theme.name: zen-linen + ink sidebar
theme.coverage: Public routes: layout shell (Navbar1, footer), landing page, /cars, /cars/[id], /checkout, /signin, /signup. Dashboard routes: /dashboard, /dashboard/bookings, /dashboard/listings, /dashboard/users, /dashboard/settings, /owner/cars/new. /owner and /admin permanently redirect to /dashboard via next.config.ts.

dashboard.shell: src/components/dashboard/DashboardShell.tsx — shadcn Sidebar (collapsible icon rail) + SidebarInset, cookie-backed default state (sidebar_state), sticky topbar with SidebarTrigger, workspace label, page title, Browse cars, and View site.
dashboard.provider: src/components/dashboard/dashboard-context.tsx — loads the localStorage session and marketplace data, then refreshes on the sw:data-changed event and cross-tab storage events.

roles.renter: Overview (active/upcoming/completed/spent + recent bookings + next trip), My bookings, Browse cars, How it works, Profile & settings.
roles.owner: Overview (active listings/requests/revenue/average rate + booking requests + fleet), Booking requests, My listings, Add a car, Browse marketplace, Profile & settings.
roles.admin: Overview (users/listings/bookings/revenue + pending approvals + platform mix + recent bookings), Bookings, Fleet, Users, Browse cars, Profile & settings.

interactions: Owner confirms or declines a requested booking; the row and KPI counters update immediately.
Renter cancels a requested or confirmed booking.
Admin approves or rejects pending cars and sets approved cars inactive.
Any role edits first name, last name, phone, and neighbourhood in Profile & settings.
Owner submits a new car and is redirected to My listings, where the pending car appears.

accessibility.evidence: Measured in rendered Chromium at 1440x900 and 390x844. Heading text rgb(46,46,46) on linen rgb(233,228,216) = 10.7:1; muted body text = 5.67:1; sidebar group labels on ink = 10.7:1; sidebar menu text on ink = 4.62:1 (all meet WCAG AA, with body/labels well above). The shadcn SidebarTrigger exposes aria-label 'Toggle Sidebar' and shows a solid 2px focus ring with a 2px offset when focused. Every icon-only booking action carries an explicit aria-label (Confirm booking, Decline booking, Cancel booking, Resolve dispute). Add-car form controls are paired with visible <Label> elements; native selects have labels; table headers are real <th> cells; status changes are rendered as text badges, not color alone. Zero page errors across all captured dashboard routes.

responsive.evidence: 16 dashboard captures at 390x844 and 1440x900 all measured documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth = 0. Below md the sidebar becomes a Sheet drawer opened by the topbar trigger; the drawer exposes the full role navigation and profile footer, closes by overlay/Escape, and introduced no overflow. KPI cards stack one per row on mobile and become 2-up at sm and 4-up at xl. Overview booking tables use a compact mode (tighter padding, icon-only actions, hidden secondary lines) so the Action column fits beside the insight panel at 1440; the dedicated bookings/users tables keep full detail and scroll inside their card rather than the page.

functional.evidence: next build compiles all 14 routes; tsc --noEmit is clean after clearing stale .next types. Live checks: owner sign-in from /signin lands on /dashboard with the sidebar and no public footer; /owner and /admin both resolve to /dashboard; signed-out /dashboard lands on /signin?next=%2Fdashboard; public / keeps navbar and footer and no sidebar. Owner confirm changed booking-demo-4 from requested to confirmed and moved Awaiting response 1 → 0 and Active trips 1 → 2. Add-car submitted Kia Rio 2022 with features ['Bluetooth','Air conditioning'], persisted it with status pending, redirected to /dashboard/listings, and rendered it in the list. Mobile drawer opened with the full owner navigation.

loading.reason: The demo resolves its localStorage session synchronously on mount and has no network data fetch; DashboardShell's Skeleton frame is a brief hydration placeholder rather than a user-visible loading state.

empty.evidence: With the owner fleet cleared, My listings renders the dashed EmptyState: 'No cars in this fleet yet' with an Add a car action, while all four KPI cards read 0. See dashboard-empty-desktop.png.

error.reason: The dashboard reads and writes localStorage only; there is no remote API or network failure path to surface in this demo.

partial.reason: Data loads as one local snapshot, so there is no partially-loaded state to render.

success.evidence: All three roles render populated overviews with seeded users, cars, and bookings; the renter, owner, and admin desktop captures show real KPI values, booking rows, and fleet/insight panels.

permission.evidence: A renter opening /dashboard/users sees the Restricted area page with an Admin access required card and a Back to dashboard action, while the sidebar omits the Users item. See dashboard-permission-desktop.png.
